items.title: Bank of Israel Slams Netanyahu’s Anti-Sanctions Crypto Proposal
items.content: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu floated using cryptocurrency to get around potential financial sanctions on Israel, prompting a strongly-worded rebuke from the central bank.
items.contentSnippet: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu floated using cryptocurrency to get around potential financial sanctions on Israel, prompting a strongly-worded rebuke from the central bank.
items.creator: Galit Altstein

summaries.zh: 内塔尼亚胡表示，以色列正在研究使用加密货币以规避可能的经济制裁。此举引发反对派批评，他们认为这将使犹太国家成为类似伊朗的经济孤立国。
summaries.en: Benjamin Netanyahu stated Israel is considering using cryptocurrency to avoid potential financial sanctions. Critics argue this would isolate Israel economically, likening it to Iran. The development reflects ongoing tensions over sanctions and Israel's financial strategies.

items.title: AI Boom Faces a Growing Public Backlash
items.content: The Atlantic CEO Nicholas Thompson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that AI offers powerful tools for businesses but poses significant risks to media, while its broader economic impact continues to lag behind rapidly advancing capabilities. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Thompson also discusses the discipline of distance running and how the sport shaped his relationship with his father and became an organizing force in his life.  (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: The Atlantic CEO Nicholas Thompson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that AI offers powerful tools for businesses but poses significant risks to media, while its broader economic impact continues to lag behind rapidly advancing capabilities. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Thompson also discusses the discipline of distance running and how the sport shaped his relationship with his father and became an organizing force in his life.  (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《大西洋》杂志总裁尼古拉斯·汤普森在接受彭博专访时表示，人工智能为企业提供了强大工具，但对媒体构成重大风险，其整体经济影响仍落后于快速发展的能力。他还谈到长跑训练如何影响他与父亲的关系，并将其作为人生的重要组织力量。（来源：彭博）
summaries.en: The Atlantic's CEO Nicholas Thompson discusses AI's dual impact in a Bloomberg interview. He notes AI's powerful business tools but highlights significant risks to media and a lagging economic impact compared to its rapid advancements. The piece also covers Thompson's personal experiences with distance running and its influence on his life and relationship with his father. (Word count: 50)

items.title: AI Boom Brings New Business to Matchmakers
items.content: Linx Dating founder and CEO Amy Andersen tells Bloomberg This Weekend that newly wealthy AI creators are fueling demand for high-end matchmaking as busy professionals seek an alternative to dating apps. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Andersen explains how her firm vets and recruits potential partners for selective clients, with matchmaking packages that can exceed $500,000. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Linx Dating founder and CEO Amy Andersen tells Bloomberg This Weekend that newly wealthy AI creators are fueling demand for high-end matchmaking as busy professionals seek an alternative to dating apps. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Andersen explains how her firm vets and recruits potential partners for selective clients, with matchmaking packages that can exceed $500,000. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 人工智能热潮催生高端婚介新业务。Linx Dating创始人兼CEO艾米·安德森表示，新兴的AI创富者正推动高端婚介需求，忙碌的专业人士寻求摆脱约会软件。该机构为精选客户筛选和招募伴侣，婚介套餐费用可超50万美元。(信息来源：彭博)
summaries.en: The AI boom has created demand for high-end matchmaking, as newly wealthy AI creators seek alternatives to dating apps. Linx Dating founder Amy Andersen told Bloomberg that busy professionals are turning to her firm for exclusive matchmaking services, which include vetting and recruiting partners for clients willing to pay over $500,000 for packages. The trend reflects a growing market for curated, high-value connections in the tech industry.

items.title: Making Advanced MicroChips Takes a Global Ecosystem
items.content: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Gideon Lewis-Kraus explains how advanced chipmaking depends on a deeply interconnected global network of specialized companies, including ASML and TSMC, making semiconductor supply chains extraordinarily difficult to replicate or relocate. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lewis-Kraus describes the remarkable engineering behind ASML’s EUV machines and why rebuilding a semiconductor ecosystem in the US is a generational project rather than a simple exercise in reshoring. (Source: Bloomberg)

Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lewis-Kraus describes the remarkable engineering behind ASML’s EUV machines and why rebuilding a semiconductor ecosystem in the US is a generational project rather than a simple exercise in reshoring. items.content: Technical colleges are betting a surge in demand for skilled workers will lift profits, though the payoff may take time as they expand campuses and programs to accommodate more students.

items.content: When he started flying unmanned aircraft in combat, “Ray” was flying some of Ukraine’s earliest mid-range strike drones, on missions of about 100 kilometers with a warhead about the weight of a bowling ball.

items.title: Malaysia May Widen Ban on Israel-Based Waze Traffic App, PM Says
items.content: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Malaysia’s security cannot be compromised as he held fast on the government’s partial ban of Google’s navigation app Waze and said authorities aren’t ruling out even wider restrictions.

summaries.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated that the country's security cannot be compromised, emphasizing the government's partial ban on the Israel-based navigation app Waze. He clarified that authorities are not ruling out imposing even stricter restrictions on the app.

items.title: UK Vows £100 Million for Biosecurity Lab With OpenAI, Anthropic
items.content: The UK announced £100 million ($134 million) for a AI Biosecurity Lab which will be supported by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind, part of a raft of measures designed to improve the government’s ability to understand and tackle the risks posed by the technology.

summaries.zh: 英国承诺拨款1亿英镑（1.34亿美元）用于建立人工智能生物安全实验室，该实验室将由OpenAI、Anthropic和谷歌DeepMind支持。此举旨在提升政府理解和应对人工智能技术风险的能力。

items.title: The Points Guy CEO: People Are Leveraging Loyalty
items.content: Brian Kelly discusses findings from The Points Guy’s State of Loyalty report, saying its focus is on where consumer trust and loyalty are growing—not simply whether people are loyal overall. Fuel and dining programs posted 88% consumer satisfaction, which Kelly links to rising everyday costs: consumers are using rewards for immediate savings while wages stagnate and expenses climb. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

Fuel and dining programs posted 88% consumer satisfaction, which Kelly links to rising everyday costs: consumers are using rewards for immediate savings while wages stagnate and expenses climb. summaries.zh: 《点数先生》首席执行官布莱恩·凯利谈及其公司发布的《忠诚度报告》发现，重点在于消费者信任和忠诚度的增长方向，而非整体忠诚度。燃油和餐饮计划获得88%的消费者满意度，凯利将其归因于日常成本上升，消费者利用积分实现即时节省，而工资停滞、支出增加。他受访于《The Close》。（来源：彭博）

Kelly discussed these insights on "The Close" with Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: AI Jitters, Oil & Big Tech
items.content: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are BlackRock Deputy CIO, Global Fixed Income Russ Brownback, AXA Group Chief Economist Gilles Moëc, Mizuho Securities Senior Equity Research Analyst Lloyd Walmsley, AlixPartners Co-CEO Rob Hornby, Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick, Teneo CoiPresident, Political Risk Advisory Kevin Kajiwara, KPMG US Principal, Consumer & Retail Strategy Julia Wilson, The Points Guy Founder & CEO Brian Kelly, & Green Bay Packers Former Vice President Andrew Brandt. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Consumers to Ramp up Holiday Spending This Year: KPMG
items.content: Julia Wilson, Principal of Consumer and Retail Strategy at KPMG US, discusses the firm’s holiday survey, which projects spending will increase 5% year over year. She says much of the rise reflects higher prices, though consumers are still willing to spend on priorities. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: AlixPartners Co-CEO Rob Hornby on AI Bull Case
items.content: Rob Hornby says AI costs are falling faster than those of comparable technologies historically, but remain substantial. He describes companies as being in a transition period: investment is underway while returns are uneven, and the shift from flat fees to per-token charges has exposed costs. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Rob Hornby says AI costs are falling faster than those of comparable technologies historically, but remain substantial. He describes companies as being in a transition period: investment is underway while returns are uneven, and the shift from flat fees to per-token charges has exposed costs. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 阿里克斯帕特公司联席CEO罗布·霍恩比表示，人工智能成本正以比同类技术历史上更快的速度下降，但仍相当可观。他认为企业正处于转型期：投资正在进行中，但回报不均，从固定费用转向按代币收费的模式也暴露了成本问题。此观点源自他与罗曼尼·博斯蒂克和杰西·门顿在《The Close》节目中的对话。（信息来源：彭博）
summaries.en: Rob Hornby, Co-CEO of AlixPartners, discusses the AI bull case, noting that AI costs are falling faster than comparable technologies historically but remain significant. He describes a transition period for companies, where investments are ongoing but returns are uneven. The shift from flat fees to per-token charges has highlighted these costs. The insights are from a conversation with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: The Urgent Need for Whistleblowers
items.content: “You Can See Everything” is the latest reminder of how whistleblowers are more important than ever. But at the same time the role is becoming more complicated — and opaque, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Beth Kowitt says. (Source: Bloomberg)
